message.content: It's a catheter that goes into my urinary pouch, the one the surgeons made after my bladder was removed. It goes in through the small opening on my belly. I'd been having trouble getting a catheter in for weeks, so they left a catheter in there to drain all the time. It stopped draining last night, and I've been making much less urine since then. As for why it was placed, it was because I couldn't catheterize myself easily anymore. I have spina bifida, I had my bladder enlarged with a piece of bowel, and later my bladder was removed for cancer. The pain came after the catheter stopped working. It's severe, low in my belly, and it's been getting worse. The shortness of breath has been getting worse too.
